Uses of Package
io.webagent4j.extraction.api

Packages that use io.webagent4j.extraction.api
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.
io.webagent4j.dom
The backend-neutral live-element vocabulary shared by the locator, action, extraction, and observation subsystems - depends only on immutable, backend-neutral contracts.
io.webagent4j.extraction
 
io.webagent4j.extraction.api
Backend-neutral extraction request/result/provenance contracts, converters, validators, and the extraction-specific failure taxonomy - depends only on webagent4j-locator-api, never on webagent4j-dom.
  • Classes in io.webagent4j.extraction.api used by io.webagent4j.browser
    Class
    Description
    ExtractedTable
    An immutable, structured reading of one accessible HTML table (table/thead/ tbody/tr/th/td).
    ExtractionRequest
    Immutable, backend-neutral description of one extraction intent: where to find the source (ExtractionRequest.source(), reusing the existing deterministic locator resolution - no second DOM resolution engine), what raw datum to read from it (ExtractionRequest.readType()), and how to deterministically convert and validate that raw value.
    ExtractionResult
    Immutable outcome of a successful extraction: the converted, validated value; the pre-conversion raw string when this result came from a single scalar read (empty for a list or table result, which aggregate many raw reads rather than carrying one); and where the value came from.
